items.headline: UK seeks views on new ecodesign standards for standby power
items.shortSummary: The UK government proposes updating ecodesign regulations for standby mode to improve energy efficiency and cut bills. The consultation closes on 25 December 2026.
items.summary: The Department for Energy Security and Net Zero is seeking views on proposals to update ecodesign standards for standby mode in Great Britain. The consultation aims to replace current regulations (1275/2008 and 107/2009) with new standards aligned with the EU Regulation (EU) 2023/826. The updates seek to enhance energy efficiency of electrical and electronic household and office equipment, reduce energy demand, and cut bills. The consultation closes at 11:59pm on 25 December 2026.
items.originalTitle: Updating standards for standby, networked standby and off mode power consumption
tags: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero

items.headline: UK government proposes new rules for supported housing
items.shortSummary: The government proposes a locally led licensing regime and new standards for supported housing. It also seeks views on changes to Housing Benefit regulations.
items.summary: The UK government has published a response to a consultation on the Supported Housing (Regulatory Oversight) Act 2023. The consultation ran from 20 February to 15 May 2025. The government is proposing a locally led licensing regime for supported housing across England. It also plans to introduce new National Supported Housing Standards. Additionally, the government is consulting on changes to Housing Benefit Regulations. The aim of these reforms is to ensure supported housing is of good quality and provides value for money for the taxpayer. The response includes feedback received during the consultation period.
items.originalTitle: Supported Housing regulation: consultation
tags: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

items.headline: Chamber proposes adding university sports to national fund
items.shortSummary: The Chamber of Deputies proposes to change the General Sports Law to include university sports promotion in the National Sports Fund's objectives.
items.summary: The Chamber of Deputies presented a bill to amend Law No. 14,597, of June 14, 2023, known as the General Sports Law. The proposal aims to include the promotion of university sports among the objectives of the National Sports Fund. The bill was presented by Deputy Dandara from the PT/MG party on October 16, 2026.
items.originalTitle: PL 5590/2026: Altera a Lei nº 14.597, de 14 de junho de 2023 Lei Geral do Esporte, para incluir o fomento do esporte universitário entre os objetivos do Fundo Nacional do Esporte.

items.headline: Economy expands Treasury bill to cancel interest with Central Bank
items.shortSummary: The Economy Ministry will issue a new Treasury bill worth US$13.5 million to replace part of the interest payments on an existing bond held by the Central Bank.
items.summary: The Argentine Economy Ministry has decided to expand the issuance of a Treasury bill to cancel interest payments. The measure, detailed in Resolution 61/2026, authorizes the issuance of a new 'Letra del Tesoro Nacional Intransferible en Dólares Estadounidenses vencimiento 15 de septiembre de 2031' with a nominal value of US$13.521.937. The bill will be delivered to the Banco Central de la República Argentina (BCRA) at par value. This operation aims to replace 60% of the interest services on an existing bond, 'Letra del Tesoro Nacional Intransferible en Dólares Estadounidenses vencimiento 20 de abril 2032', which matures on October 20, 2026. The decision is based on the Budget Law for Fiscal Year 2026 and the Public Credit System regulations.
items.originalTitle: Economía amplió una letra del Tesoro para cancelar intereses con el Banco Central
tags: Banco Central de la República Argentina

items.headline: Argentina approves internal audit guidelines for SAMIC hospitals
items.shortSummary: The Nation's General Sindicatura approved specific guidelines for the internal audit units of SAMIC hospitals starting in 2027. The resolution sets out how these units must organize and plan their…
items.summary: The Nation's General Sindicatura approved specific guidelines for the internal audit units of SAMIC hospitals starting in 2027. The resolution, number 312/2026, establishes how these units must organize and plan their work. It requires the creation of a Control Committee within 60 days of the first head's designation, except for the Juan P. Garrahan Pediatric Hospital. The guidelines also detail the use of the Corrective Actions Tracking System (SISAC) and specific criteria for auditing hospital processes like pharmacy and waste management.
items.originalTitle: Actualizaron los criterios de auditoría interna para los hospitales SAMIC que incorporen unidades de control
tags: HOSPITAL DE PEDIATRÍA SAMIC "PROF. DR. JUAN P. GARRAHAN"

items.headline: Cabinet extends 'Confiscated Goods Unit' until Dec 2027
items.shortSummary: The Cabinet extended the temporary unit for managing confiscated goods until 9 December 2027. The move ensures the continued administration of assets seized in legal and domain-extinction processes.
items.summary: The Cabinet of Ministers has extended the validity of the Special Temporary Executor Unit "UNIDAD BIENES DECOMISADOS" until 9 December 2027. The unit, dependent on the State Goods Administration Agency, manages the administration, conservation, and disposal of confiscated or recovered goods in judicial and domain-extinction processes. The extension was approved by Resolution 327/2026 and is necessary to maintain the continuity of administrative and operational functions while a judicial measure affects a related regime. The measure is funded by specific budget items for the State Goods Administration Agency.
items.originalTitle: La Jefatura de Gabinete extendió la vigencia de la Unidad de Bienes Decomisados
tags: Secretariat of Legal and Administrative Coordination

items.headline: SENASA authorises health entities to distribute electronic animal ID devices
items.shortSummary: The SENASA authorised local health entities to distribute and place electronic identification devices for cattle, buffalo and deer. They can also read the devices and send data to the national system.
items.summary: The National Service of Agrifood Health and Quality (SENASA) authorised local health entities, anti-foot-and-mouth disease foundations and other entities to distribute electronic identification devices for cattle, buffalo and deer. The entities can buy the devices directly from authorised providers, sell them to producers and place the devices on the animals. They must also read the devices using the SIGBioTraza application and send the data to the Integrated Management System for Animal Health (SIGSA). The resolution establishes rules for the entities to keep records of the devices for five years and allows the SENASA to suspend the authorisation if irregularities are found.
items.originalTitle: Habilitaron a entidades sanitarias a distribuir y colocar identificadores electrónicos para el ganado

items.headline: Chamber of Deputies presents bill to regulate image consulting profession
items.shortSummary: The Chamber of Deputies presented a bill to regulate the profession of image consultant. The proposal aims to establish rules for the field.
items.summary: The Chamber of Deputies presented bill PL 5589/2026. The bill regulates the profession of image consultant. The proposal establishes rules for the field. The text was presented by deputy Fábio Macedo from PODE/MA on 16/10/2026.
items.originalTitle: PL 5589/2026: Dispõe sobre a regulamentação da profissão de Consultor de Imagem.

items.headline: Chamber proposes bill to limit government benefits during election years
items.shortSummary: The Chamber of Deputies proposed a bill to restrict government benefits during election years. It requires financial proof before creating new benefits.
items.summary: The Chamber of Deputies presented bill PLP 270/2026. The bill changes the Fiscal Responsibility Law and the Electoral Law. It sets limits on creating, instituting, expanding, or granting government benefits during election years. It also requires a prior demonstration of budget and financial adequacy. The goal is to strengthen the prevention of using public machinery for electoral purposes.
items.originalTitle: PLP 270/2026: Altera a Lei Complementar nº 101, de 4 de maio de 2000 (Lei de Responsabilidade Fiscal), e a Lei nº 9.504, de 30 de setembro de 1997 (Lei das Eleições), para estabelecer restrições à criação, instituição, ampliação e concessão de benefícios governamentais no ano em que se realizarem eleições, exigir demonstração prévia de adequação orçamentária e financeira e fortalecer a prevenção ao uso eleitoral da máquina pública.

items.headline: Deputada Dandara propõe ampliar compras da agricultura familiar no Programa Nacional de…
items.shortSummary: Deputada Dandara apresentou um projeto de lei para aumentar o limite anual de compra de alimentos da agricultura familiar no Programa Nacional de Alimentação Escolar.
items.summary: A deputada Dandara apresentou o Projeto de Lei 5588/2026. O projeto altera a Lei nº 11.947, de 16 de junho de 2009. A alteração visa ampliar o limite anual de aquisição de gêneros alimentícios da agricultura familiar. A compra será feita através do Cadastro Nacional da Agricultura Familiar. O objetivo é dentro do âmbito do Programa Nacional de Alimentação Escolar. A proposição foi apresentada em 16/10/2026.
items.originalTitle: PL 5588/2026: Altera a Lei nº 11.947, de 16 de junho de 2009, para ampliar o limite anual de aquisição de gêneros alimentícios da agricultura familiar, por Cadastro Nacional da Agricultura Familiar, no âmbito do Programa Nacional de Alimentação Escolar.

items.headline: Mexico creates National Intelligence Academy
items.shortSummary: Mexico creates the National Intelligence Academy as a decentralised organ of the Security and Citizen Protection Secretariat.
items.summary: The Official Gazette of the Federation published an agreement to create the National Intelligence Academy. The academy is a decentralised administrative organ of the Security and Citizen Protection Secretariat. The agreement establishes the creation of the institution.
items.originalTitle: Acuerdo por el que se crea la Academia del Centro Nacional de Inteligencia, Órgano Administrativo Desconcentrado de la Secretaría de Seguridad y Protección Ciudadana.

items.headline: INE sets precampaign criteria and deadlines for 2026-27 federal election
items.shortSummary: The National Electoral Institute established rules and timelines for the precampaign period of the 2026-27 federal election process.
items.summary: The National Electoral Institute's General Council issued an agreement to set the criteria and deadlines for procedures related to the precampaign period for the 2026-27 federal election process. The document outlines the specific rules that candidates and political parties must follow during this initial phase of the electoral cycle.
items.originalTitle: Acuerdo del Consejo General del Instituto Nacional Electoral por el que se establecen los criterios y plazos de procedimientos relacionados con el periodo de precampañas para el Proceso Electoral Federal 2026-2027.

items.headline: Federal entities must avoid contracts with AM Cenit
items.shortSummary: The government orders federal, state and local entities to stop doing business with AM Cenit, S.A. de C.V.
items.summary: The Federal Government issued a circular ordering all federal, state and municipal public entities, as well as public bodies and Mexico City territorial demarcations, to abstain from accepting proposals or signing contracts with the company AM Cenit, S.A. de C.V. The measure applies to all public administration bodies across the country. The order aims to prevent the company from receiving public contracts.
items.originalTitle: Circular por la que se comunica a las dependencias y entidades de la Administración Pública Federal, a las entidades federativas, municipios, los entes públicos de unas y otros, así como a las demarcaciones territoriales de la Ciudad de México, que deberán abstenerse de aceptar propuestas y/o celebrar contratos con la empresa AM Cenit, S.A. de C.V.

items.headline: Tribunal Federal de Justicia Administrativa suspends Guerrero regional activities
items.shortSummary: The Tribunal Federal de Justicia Administrativa suspends the activities of its Guerrero regional chamber due to force majeure.
items.summary: The Tribunal Federal de Justicia Administrativa issued Acuerdo SRG/03/2026. The agreement announces the suspension of the judicial activities of the Sala Regional in Guerrero. The suspension is due to force majeure. This means an unforeseen event beyond control.
items.originalTitle: Acuerdo SRG/03/2026 por el que se da a conocer la suspensión de actividades jurisdiccionales de la Sala Regional en Guerrero del Tribunal Federal de Justicia Administrativa, por causa de fuerza mayor.

items.headline: Mexico modifies 2026 federal transfers for states and municipalities
items.shortSummary: The government updated the calendar for distributing federal funds to states and municipalities for 2026, specifically for health services.
items.summary: The Mexican government published an amendment to a previous agreement. The change updates the distribution and calendar for the administration of federal resources. These resources are for the fiscal year 2026. They belong to two general branches: General Branch 28, which are participations for states and municipalities, and General Branch 33, which are federal contributions for states and municipalities. The amendment specifically modifies the rules for the Health Services Contribution Fund. The original agreement was published on 12 December 2025. This amendment follows previous modifications published on 6 February, 8 April, and 9 July 2026.
items.originalTitle: Acuerdo por el que se modifica el diverso por el que se da a conocer a los gobiernos de las entidades federativas la distribución y calendarización para la ministración, durante el ejercicio fiscal de 2026, de los recursos correspondientes a los Ramos Generales 28 Participaciones a Entidades Federativas y Municipios y 33 Aportaciones Federales para Entidades Federativas y Municipios, publicado el 12 de diciembre de 2025, y sus modificaciones publicadas el 6 de febrero, 8 de abril, y 9 de julio d
tags: Fondo de Aportaciones para los Servicios de Salud

items.headline: Science Freedom Law expanded for non-profit research
items.shortSummary: The Science Freedom Law was expanded to help non-profit research institutions compete internationally and contribute to the common good.
items.summary: The Science Freedom Law was expanded to allow non-profit research institutions to compete internationally for top talent. The measure aims to help these institutions contribute to the common good through their research. The expansion is intended to strengthen the position of non-profit research in the global competition for the best researchers.
items.originalTitle: Wissenschaftsfreiheitsgesetz erweitert

items.headline: CMA proposes Microsoft has strategic market status
items.shortSummary: The CMA proposes designating Microsoft as having strategic market status in its business software ecosystem. The regulator invites comments on this decision by 13 November 2026.
items.summary: The Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) has published a proposed decision to designate Microsoft as having strategic market status (SMS) in respect of its business software ecosystem. The regulator launched an investigation into this matter on 14 May 2026. The proposed decision sets out the CMA's provisional assessment that Microsoft meets the statutory conditions for SMS designation. The CMA invites comments on the proposed decision and accompanying documents by 5pm on 13 November 2026. The regulator will take a final decision by 13 February 2027.
items.originalTitle: Proposed decision: SMS investigation into Microsoft’s business software ecosystem

items.headline: Bundesregierung will staatliche Zuschuss für Altersvorsorge einführen
items.shortSummary: Die Bundesregierung plant die Einführung einer Frühstartrente. Das ist ein staatlicher Zuschuss für die Altersvorsorge der jungen Generation.
items.summary: Die Bundesregierung plant die Einführung einer Frühstartrente. Das ist ein staatlicher Zuschuss für die Altersvorsorge der jungen Generation. Das Geld soll am Kapitalmarkt angelegt werden. So sollen Kinder frühzeitig von den Renditemöglichkeiten profitieren und für das Alter sparen können.
items.originalTitle: Startkapital für private Altersvorsorge

items.headline: EU sets first cyber security standards for smart devices
items.shortSummary: The EU proposes a regulation to set minimum cyber security standards for smart devices, software and other products with digital elements.
items.summary: The European Union proposes a new regulation to set the first minimum standards for cyber security in smart devices, software and other products with digital elements. The measure aims to make Europe more resilient against cyber attacks and ensure safe digital services. The proposal is the first step towards a common framework for digital product safety.
items.originalTitle: Mehr Resilienz für Smart-Geräte

items.headline: Bundestag approves law proposal for victims of serious crimes
items.shortSummary: The Bundestag approved a government proposal to make it easier for victims of serious crimes to get professional psychological support during court proceedings.
items.summary: The Bundestag has approved a government proposal to strengthen the rights of victims. The measure aims to make it easier for victims of serious crimes to obtain professional psychological support during court proceedings. The proposal is currently in the legislative process.
items.originalTitle: Mehr professionelle Unterstützung für Betroffene
